items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1969-12-30
items.q: Caffrey's been dead for years. His wife is still living in Dallas. ... Well Caffrey got into the underworld business in Dallas by just about the time that I brought my little band there.

ctx.x: So it may well have been him on that date. Yeah, I'm sure it does. I'm almost positive. You don't remember him being in the studio or anything? Yes, I do. You remember him being there? Yes, I do. Oh, well that's great. I'm glad to know.
Caffrey's been dead for years. His wife is still living in Dallas.
Yeah, well he had a sort of a bad life on the end.
